coreServices.title: We can help solve all your Legal disputes in Saudi Arabia
coreServices.description: Expertly steering your organization through the intricacies of immigration law and regulations. We focus on streamlining your global workforce mobility with accuracy and operational excellence.

items.title: Corporate Immigration
items.description: When it comes to corporate immigration matters, we assist businesses, corporations, and individuals seeking to relocate employees, expand operations internationally, or hire foreign talent needed for international projects while staying compliant with immigration laws and policies. We align immigration strategies with your business goals to optimize talent acquisition and mobility.

items.title: Company Incorporation
items.description: Northman Sterling is dedicated to assisting its global clients at every stage of their company setup journey. We lead companies looking to expand through the entire process of business incorporation and provide guidance on compliance matters, such as corporate registration, licensing, permits, and annual reporting to maintain your business status.

items.title: Outbound Visas
items.description: Northman Sterling offers assistance with immigration matters for the UK, Canada, USA and Australia from the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Depending on our client's choice of visa, they can collaborate with us to procure necessary documents, review application materials for quality assurance prior to submission, and monitor the status and progress of the case.

items.title: Document Attestation
items.description: Managing documents effectively is crucial for businesses and organizations to maintain efficiency, compliance, and security. We ensure that you meet all regulatory requirements whether you are a professional, a corporate entity, or a small business, our comprehensive solution is tailored to your specific needs.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Us?
whyChooseUs.imageAlt: A legal advisor reviewing documents at a laptop
paragraphs: Northman Sterling Legal serves as a central hub for legal services in Saudi Arabia, providing comprehensive solutions that help businesses navigate complex legal, regulatory, and compliance landscapes.

We are dedicated to supporting organizations across diverse industries, empowering them to operate confidently within the Saudi legal framework while focusing on their strategic growth and core objectives.
Guiding you through the complexities of commercial litigation, dispute resolution, and court order enforcement in Saudi Arabia with clarity, expertise, and precision.
We are committed to making every legal process seamless, ensuring that each stage is handled efficiently, transparently, and with your best interests at the forefront.

legalAdvisors.title: Your Legal Advisors
legalAdvisors.imageAlt: A Northman Sterling legal advisor consulting with a client
paragraphs: We proudly serve as your trusted legal services partner in Saudi Arabia, guiding clients through the complexities of local laws and regulatory frameworks. Our team collaborates with leading legal and compliance experts to deliver practical, results-driven solutions.

Businesses of all sizes rely on us for our commitment to precision, professionalism, and excellence. We approach every matter with diligence and urgency, ensuring that our legal support is both strategic and effective in protecting your interests and achieving your goals.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.intro: Northman Sterling Legal is a registered law firm in Saudi Arabia, providing legal advisory and compliance services for enterprises and individuals operating in the Kingdom.

companyOverview.heading: Northman & Sterling is the Leading Provider of Legal Advisory & Compliance Services in Saudi Arabia
paragraphs: We assist companies operating and expanding in Saudi Arabia by managing their legal and compliance requirements. We ensure businesses remain aligned with Saudi regulations while focusing on growth and operational efficiency.
Our team assists with legal documentation, regulatory approvals, and risk management, making corporate expansion in the Kingdom structured and secure.

faqItems.question: What areas does Northman Sterling practice in?
faqItems.answer: We focus on three core areas: global immigration solutions for corporates and individuals, commercial disputes and court enforcement, and authorized notary and Power of Attorney issuance.

faqItems.question: Do you work with clients based outside Saudi Arabia?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We regularly support clients from more than 35 countries on matters connected to Saudi Arabia, coordinating remotely and through our Riyadh office as needed.

faqItems.question: How do I get in touch about a matter?
faqItems.answer: Use the contact form on our Contact Us page with a short description of your matter, and our team will respond promptly to arrange next steps.

faqItems.question: Can you notarize documents for use outside the Kingdom?
faqItems.answer: We provide authorized notarization and Power of Attorney issuance for documents used both within Saudi Arabia and internationally — get in touch with the specifics of your document and destination country for guidance.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Northman Sterling collects, uses, and protects information submitted through this website.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, and message content when you use our contact form, along with standard technical data (such as browser type and pages visited) collected automatically through analytics tools.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information you provide to respond to your inquiry, and we use aggregated analytics data to understand how visitors use this site and to improve it. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.body: This site uses cookies for analytics purposes. You can choose whether to allow analytics cookies through the consent banner shown on your first visit.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us using the details on our Contact Us page.

sections.heading: No Guarantee of Outcome
sections.body: Legal outcomes depend on the specific facts of each matter. Nothing on this site should be taken as a guarantee or prediction of the outcome of any legal matter.

sections.heading: Seek Professional Advice
